title: Annotations on a Budget: Leveraging Geo-Data Similarity to Balance Model Performance and Annotation Cost
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the visual diversity of the topic 'religious building' across 52 countries. It calculated the cosine similarity of image embeddings to determine how visually different images of religious buildings are between low-resource countries and high-resource, web-scraped datasets (like ImageNet and LAION).
findings: The topic 'religious building' was found to be the most visually diverse topic across countries, with the lowest average similarity score (0.76). This indicates that the visual appearance of religious buildings varies significantly across different geographical locations, and this category would benefit most from wider annotation to improve the performance of vision-language models.
